source: CAMELS SIMBA CV24-26 subhalos thinned by official ARES completeness_12_5 map
finding: Across all validation realizations and six stellar-mass populations, Bernoulli survival frequencies agree with the ARES map expectation within binomial uncertainty.
scope_limit: This calibrates angular survival only. It does not calibrate CF4 luminosity-dependent radial selection or Carrick-tracer bias.
implication: The v7 nuisance boundary is not evidence that the ARES angular map is wrong; it indicates non-identifiability between CF4 tracer response and the Carrick reference covariate.
